purpose: Warm the near-white outer backgrounds of three Fire illustrations to match the existing collection; keep their character designs and red circles.

cards.name: Lucan
cards.prompt:
Perform a minimal background-colour edit on image 1, which is the actual card illustration to modify. Images 2 and 3 are palette references only; do not copy their characters, composition, objects or backgrounds.
Replace only the bright near-white / pale ivory OUTER BACKDROP surrounding the existing brick-red circular field with a gently warm pale cream/parchment, approximately #f6dfb2, matching the subtle warmth of the existing Fire-card reference collection. Keep the main red circle's colour, size and shape exactly as in image 1. Keep the pale ground shadows and their geometry intact, blending the recoloured backdrop naturally into them. The cream should be quiet and light, not orange, brown or dark.
This is NOT a redesign or repaint. Preserve image 1's character, drawing, linework, shading, saturation, composition, camera, proportions and all object placements exactly. Lucan's exact pose, two connected hindlegs, slim tail, paw/toe anatomy, clay wheel and cups; his cream cap stopping before the ear; the two matching cream apron straps; and the red apron must remain unchanged.
Do not recolour any white/cream fur, clothing, cap, cuffs, straps, highlights or other foreground objects. Do not apply a global warm filter. Do not modify faces, paws, eyes, ears, costume, props, or fire. Preserve the same flat illustrated trading-card art style. No text, card border, watermark, new detail or new scenery. Keep a square opaque background, the original crop, and the original dimensions if possible. The only visible difference should be that the overly white outer background is now a restrained warm cream.
